spec.name: Festival de l'Amande d'Aït Tagla
spec.description: Annual harvest festival in the rural commune of Aït Tagla (Azilal province, Middle Atlas) valorizing the local almond sector, combining tbourida equestrian displays, a local-products pavilion, folkloric performances and workshops for farmers and cooperatives.

editions.notes: Theme: 'Traditional tbourida, an ancestral heritage'; organized with the Ait Tagla territorial collectivity and the union of Ait Tagla tbourida associations; 46 tbourida groups
Organized in partnership with the commune of Ait Tagla (president Khalid Ejlaydy) and the Béni Mellal-Khénifra regional council; coincided with Eid Al Mawlid celebrations
